basic_info.description: Standing bold and beautiful on a gorgeous flat and tree-lined block of Vallejo St. in Pacific Heights, this grand dame Victorian manor embodies luxury and sophistication.  It is quintessential San Francisco living.  The home has been renovated with an open entertainment floor featuring designer finishes while maintaining its classic architectural detailing throughout.  The kitchen features Viking and Sub Zero appliances.  The two floors of bedrooms above have a total of either 4 Bedrooms and office or five bedrooms.   The bottom level features a full guest suite and family room with separated entrance and mud room. There is a 2-car side-by-side garage and a wine room and large laundry room.  The unmatched features that don't show up in pictures are a superb walk-out backyard all on the same level as the kitchen. The proximity to schools, and the flat streets make this stroller friendly and ideal family home. This is San Francisco living at its best.
